definitions.name: W1B.R1
definitions.note: one pass deleting adjacent () then [] pairs from a String

definitions.name: W1B.REDUCE
definitions.body: W1B.R1 W1B.R1 W1B.R1 W1B.R1 W1B.R1 W1B.R1
definitions.note: bracket String (<=12 chars) with all matched pairs deleted repeatedly

definitions.name: W1B.ISBAL
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly balanced

definitions.name: W1B.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined by single spaces

definitions.name: W1B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String with first letter upper-cased, rest unchanged

definitions.name: W1B.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'RC' BIND RC KEYS RC VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record key -> number: key with the largest value, first on ties

definitions.name: W1B.RLE
definitions.body: 'VV' BIND VV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 'SD' BIND VV SD [ 'X' BIND 'AC' BIND X 1 0 X AC 0 GET EQ NOT SELECT AC 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP VV GROUP VALUES [ 'G' BIND G 0 GET G LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: run-length encoding of a non-empty Vector: [ [ value count ] ... ]

definitions.name: W1B.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP LE [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] -> Record name to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: W1B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SV' BIND SV SV LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SV SV LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'C' BIND -1 1 '([)]' C SEARCH 1 GT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS '' [ 2 COLLECT JOIN ] SCAN [ W1B.ISBAL ] FILTER [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: W1B.BYNAME 'RC' BIND RC KEYS [ 'KY' BIND RC KY GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ W1B.CAP ] MAP W1B.UNWORDS
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'WS' BIND WS WS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.upruns: 'VV' BIND VV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 'SD' BIND VV SD [ 'X' BIND 'AC' BIND X 0 1 X AC 0 GET GT SELECT AC 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP TALLY VALUES 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'VV' BIND VV TALLY 'RC' BIND RC KEYS [ 'KY' BIND RC KY GET 2 MUL VV LENGTH GT ] FILTER 0 GET
solutions.sensor.filled: 'RD' BIND RD RD [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'AC' BIND AC X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: W1B.MISSING 'MM' BIND [ 0 ] MM CONCAT 'PP' BIND PP 1 DROP PP -1 DROP SUB 0 MAX G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: W1B.MISSING 0 [ 'X' BIND 1 ADD X MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'RD' BIND RD 1 DROP RD -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'RD' BIND RD [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'MX' BIND RD MX DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'XS' BIND XS XS W1B.MEDIAN SUB W1B.ABS W1B.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'XS' BIND XS -2 DROP XS 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD XS 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'XS' BIND XS XS 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
